name: goal-controller-monorepo
description: Controller Synthesis from Goal Models - Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm run dev:dialect" "pnpm run dev:goal-language" "pnpm run dev:goal-tree" "pnpm run dev:lib" "pnpm run dev:ui"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:lib && pnpm run build:ui
scripts.build:lib: pnpm run build:dialect && pnpm run build:goal-language && pnpm run build:goal-tree && pnpm --filter @goal-controller/lib run build
scripts.test: pnpm run build:lib && pnpm --filter @goal-controller/dialect run test && pnpm --filter @goal-controller/goal-language run test && pnpm --filter @goal-controller/goal-tree run test && pnpm --filter @goal-controller/lib run test
scripts.clean: pnpm --recursive run clean && rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules
